_comment: Labelled sentences for `pipeline nlp eval-context`. `target` is the
concept/entity the assertion is about; `expected` is one of AFFIRMED,
NEGATED, HISTORICAL, HYPOTHETICAL, CONDITIONAL, THIRD_PARTY, UNKNOWN.
Cases marked hard_negative are the ones the tranche exists to get right
-- their pass/fail is reported separately. Grow this from the live
warehouse before trusting the per-class numbers.
